subject: Re: Kickoff: muNet multitask evolution — closing decisions
body:
Team,

Decisions for the May 11 close:

1) The adoption proposal goes forward with a phased plan: migrate 4 of the 11 forks in Q3 using the clean-to-noisy curriculum heuristic, which held up in Yara's follow-up runs (freeze-then-branch also helped — thanks Hyun — and it's in the proposal as the isolation mechanism for the noisiest task).
2) Headline numbers for the proposal: fork-level quality at 41% fewer added parameters per task, and one serving artifact instead of four.
3) Scope cut: full 11-fork migration is explicitly not proposed for Q3. The ordering-sensitivity result means we earn trust four tasks at a time.
4) Milan's port is done and documented, so his roll-off at end of May is clean; serving integration lands with the platform team in Q3.

Proposal draft to this thread by Friday for review before I take it to Hana.

Anders
